name: Sean Newberry
summary: Sean is an OnlyFans model/creator who runs a network of Instagram pages (personal branding + traffic pages for his OF) and came in on 2026-06-09 needing Instagram account recovery and shadow-ban removal after a linked cluster of accounts — including his personal IG and Facebook — got banned at once. He was quoted ~$2.5k initially, then ~$6k for all four accounts, and negotiated the disabled-account recovery down to $3.5k; he balked at pricing, said a previous provider charged him $3k and that shadow bans should be ~$500, and no payment appears to have gone through. He was working with Kartik at the time; on 2026-08-04 Derrek re-engaged directly, disclosed the split with Kartik, and offered a cheaper pay-after-delivery arrangement. Warm lead — he replied "Yeah" to still needing @seanerezik and @seanmikas fixed, so follow up with a firm price and turnaround.
key_facts: Accounts: @seanmikas (disabled/banned), @seanerezik (171k, shadowbanned, his biggest/monetized page), @ofseanmicheal (86k, verified, shadowbanned), @seankeegren (43k, verified, shadowbanned)
Quotes discussed: $2.5k initially, ~$6k total for all 4, $4k for the disabled account, negotiated to $3.5k
Never paid — pushed back on price; said a previous provider quoted $3k and that shadow bans should be ~$500
Says he paid $1.5k before to recover the same account; this is his second mass-ban incident
No crypto — asked to pay via Cash App or Zelle instead of BTC
Shared login for @seanmikas (password was sent in plain text — treat as compromised/rotate)
Bought a brand-new phone on advice after the ban; had already moved to a new iCloud and phone line previously
Mentioned 'Jasmine' as someone who had paid via BTC (likely another client/referral source)
Was originally handled through Kartik; Derrek cut ties with Kartik and re-approached him 2026-08-04 with no-upfront-payment terms
Runs multiple devices with different IMEIs to isolate his OF traffic accounts from personal accounts
Image attachments could not be opened (HEIC conversion blocked in this session) — classification is from the text transcript only
services_discussed: Facebook account recovery (personal FB banned in the same cluster)
Account-linking hygiene and ban-prevention advice (unlinking personal from work accounts, device/iCloud separation)
Monetization/reach restoration on a 171k IG page
